sources.snippet: Franka Pico4 ACT (c3) Private deployment artifact for the LeRobot ACT policy trained on the c3_red_yellow_blue_edited condition (red and yellow real data plus edited-blue data). Policy: ACT, full fine-tuning (not LoRA) Checkpoint: 10,000 training steps (010000) LeRobot: 0.6.2 (PyTorch) Inputs: two RGB cameras, observation.images.top and observation.images.wrist, 480x640 at 30 FPS ...
